title: Spell Cards
text:
Level 1


  
    Command1st Level
    Enchantment · Cleric (Acolyte)
    
      Cast: ActionRange: 60 ft
      Comp: VDur: 1 round
    
    WIS save or obey a one-word command on their next turn. Examples: Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt. No effect on undead or creatures that don't understand the language.
    ↑ +1 extra target per slot level above 1st
    Acolyte background (Cleric)
  

  
    Magic Missile1st Level
    Evocation · Wizard
    
      Cast: ActionRange: 120 ft
      Comp: V, SDur: Instant
    
    Create 3 darts of magical force, each dealing 1d4 + 1 damage. Auto-hit — no attack roll. Can split between targets freely. Each dart hits individually.
    ↑ +1 dart per slot level above 1st (4 darts @ 2nd, 5 @ 3rd…)
    Wizard spellbook
  

  
    Mage Armor ⭐1st Level · PREPARED
    Abjuration · Wizard
    
      Cast: ActionRange: Touch
      Comp: V, S, M (leather)Dur: 8 hours
    
    Surround the target with protective magical force. Target's AC becomes 13 + DEX modifier (currently AC 15 for Tiberius). Only works if target wears no armour. Ends if they don armour.
    Wizard spellbook · Cast daily at start of day
  

  
    Grease1st Level
    Conjuration · Magic Initiate (Cleric)
    
      Cast: ActionRange: 60 ft
      Comp: V, S, M (butter)Dur: 1 min
    
    A 10-ft square becomes difficult terrain. Each creature in the area on cast: DEX save or fall Prone. Same save when entering or ending a turn there.
    Magic Initiate (Cleric)
  

  
    Unseen Servant1st Level
    Conjuration · Wizard
    Ritual
    
      Cast: Action / Ritual +10 minRange: 60 ft
      Comp: V, S, MDur: 1 hour
    
    Invisible mindless servant (STR 2, AC 10, 1 HP). Carries ≤ 25 lbs. Performs simple tasks: open doors, carry items, clean, pour drinks. Disappears at 0 HP.
    Wizard spellbook (ritual — no slot needed)
  

  
    Find Familiar1st Level
    Conjuration · Wizard
    Ritual
    
      Cast: 1 hr ritualRange: 10 ft
      Comp: V, S, M (10 gp consumed)Dur: Until dismissed
    
    Summon a spirit in animal form (bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, rat, raven, sea horse, spider, weasel). Share senses as a Bonus Action. Deliver touch spells through familiar. Reappears after 0 HP with re-casting.
    Wizard spellbook (ritual — no slot needed)
  

  
    Comprehend Languages1st Level
    Divination · Wizard
    Ritual
    
      Cast: Action / Ritual +10 minRange: Self
      Comp: V, S, MDur: 1 hour
    
    Understand any spoken language you hear. Understand any written language you see (must touch surface; 1 min/page). Does not grant ability to speak the language.
    Wizard spellbook (ritual — no slot needed)
  

  
    Tenser's Floating Disk1st Level
    Conjuration · Wizard
    Ritual
    
      Cast: Action / Ritual +10 minRange: 30 ft
      Comp: V, S, MDur: 1 hour
    
    3-ft wide disk of force hovering 1 ft off the ground. Carries up to 500 lbs. Follows you within 20 ft automatically. Stays put if you move farther. Vanishes if you are more than 100 ft away.
    Wizard spellbook (ritual — no slot needed)
  

  
    Silent Image1st (cast @ 2nd slot)
    Illusion · Wizard
    C
    
      Cast: ActionRange: 60 ft
      Comp: V, S, M (fleece)Dur: Conc., 10 min
    
    Create a 15-ft cube visual illusion (no sound, smell, or texture). Creatures that interact and succeed on Investigation vs DC 13 see through it. Use an Action to move it up to 20 ft.
    Requires a 2nd-level slot to cast
    Wizard spellbook
  

  
    Silvery Barbs1st (cast @ 2nd slot)
    Enchantment · Wizard
    Reaction
    
      Cast: ReactionRange: 60 ft
      Comp: VDur: Instant
    
    Trigger: a creature within 60 ft succeeds on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.Effect: that roll becomes a failure. Then choose a different creature you can see — it gains advantage on its next d20 roll (attack, check, or save).
    Requires a 2nd-level slot to cast
    Wizard spellbook
  

  
    Color Spray1st (cast @ 3rd slot)
    Illusion · Wizard
    
      Cast: ActionRange: Self (15-ft cone)
      Comp: V, S, M (sand/powder)Dur: 1 round
    
    Creatures in cone are Blinded for 1 round. Affects creatures starting from lowest HP upward, until 6d10 HP worth are blinded. Undead and creatures that can't be blinded are immune.
    ↑ +2d10 HP worth per slot above 1st. Requires 3rd-level slot.
    Wizard spellbook

title: Spell Cards
text:
Level 2


  
    Magic Weapon2nd (cast @ 3rd slot)
    Transmutation · Wizard
    C
    
      Cast: Bonus ActionRange: Touch
      Comp: V, SDur: Conc., 1 hour
    
    A nonmagical weapon becomes magical with +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. Bypasses resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.
    ↑ +2 bonus @ 4th-level slot · +3 bonus @ 6th-level slot. Requires 3rd-level slot.
    Wizard spellbook
  

  
    Nystul's Magic Aura2nd Level
    Illusion · Wizard (Illusionist)
    
      Cast: ActionRange: Touch
      Comp: V, S, M (tiny square of silk)Dur: 24 hours
    
    Alter one creature or object's magical aura detected by spells. Choose two effects: (1) False Aura — make nonmagical appear magical or vice versa, choose school; (2) Mask — change apparent creature type for divinations. Lasts 30 days if cast daily for 30 days.
    Wizard spellbook (Illusionist)
  

  
    Invisibility2nd Level
    Illusion · Wizard (Illusionist)
    C
    
      Cast: ActionRange: Touch
      Comp: V, S, M (eyelash in gum arabic)Dur: Conc., 1 hour
    
    Target becomes Invisible. Everything worn or carried is also invisible. Ends immediately if target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
    ↑ +1 additional target per slot above 2nd
    Wizard spellbook (Illusionist)
  

  
    Rope Trick2nd (cast @ 3rd — Slot B)
    Transmutation · Wizard
    
      Cast: ActionRange: Touch
      Comp: V, S, M (powdered corn)Dur: 1 hour
    
    A rope rises vertically to 60 ft. The top opens to an extradimensional space large enough for up to 8 Medium creatures. The entrance is invisible from outside. Creatures inside can see out as through a 3-ft × 5-ft window. Rope can be pulled in. Everyone exits when spell ends.
    Requires 3rd-level slot (Slot B)
    Wizard spellbook

title: Item Acquisitions Log
text:
Weapon · Uncommon · No attunement required

Acquired Sess. 0 · 2026-05-22 · Cost: 600 GP
When you throw this javelin and speak its command word, it transforms into a bolt of lightning, forming a line 5 feet wide and 120 feet long. Each creature in the line (excluding you) must succeed on a DC 13 DEX saving throw or take 4d6 lightning damage (half on success). The javelin then returns to its normal form at the target point. Can’t be used this way again until the next dawn.
